title: Incorrect envvar check
detail: The condition `if self.show_envvar and self.envvar:` will evaluate to False for empty strings and empty lists, which means the error hint won't be shown even when it should. This is a logic error because an empty envvar should still trigger the display of the hint in some cases.

title: Incorrect auto-envvar logic
detail: The condition `if not envvar and (...)` will incorrectly trigger when envvar is an empty string or empty list, causing the auto-envvar prefix logic to run even when it shouldn't. This can lead to incorrect environment variable resolution.

title: Incorrect envvar check in help display
detail: The condition `if envvar:` will evaluate to False for empty strings and empty lists, causing the environment variable to not be displayed in help text when it should be handled properly.

title: Potential charset handling issue with StringPayload
detail: The code uses aiohttp.payload.StringPayload with content_type set to self.headers["Content-Type"], but it doesn't validate that the Content-Type header actually contains a valid charset. If the Content-Type is malformed or missing, this could lead to incorrect encoding behavior or errors when sending requests.

title: Inconsistent header key handling
detail: The code normalizes 'content-type' to 'Content-Type' but doesn't ensure that all headers are properly normalized. This could lead to inconsistencies in how headers are processed if the original headers dictionary contains keys with different casing or format.

title: Method signature change breaks compatibility
detail: The reset method now returns a boolean value, but the original complete method returned None. This change breaks backward compatibility for any code that expected to call complete() and get None as return value.

title: Async method reference in sync context
detail: Similar to the server issue, this line references _reset which is an async function but is passed to HTTPStream constructor that likely expects a synchronous callable.

title: Async method in sync context
detail: The _reset method is defined as async but is being used in a synchronous context, which will cause runtime errors when trying to call it.

title: Incorrect method reference in stream creation
detail: The code replaces the old _complete method with _reset, but the new _reset method is defined as an async function while being passed to HTTPStream constructor which expects a sync callable. This will cause a TypeError when trying to create the stream.

title: Async method called in sync context
detail: The _reset() method is defined as async but is being called synchronously in the handle_requests method. This will cause a runtime error because an async function cannot be called without await.

title: Race condition in stream management
detail: There's a potential race condition in the _serve method where streams are filtered and appended to _streams. If multiple threads access this section simultaneously, it could lead to inconsistent state or duplicate entries in _streams.

title: KeyboardInterrupt handling in loop
detail: The code adds a try-except block around sleep(1) to handle KeyboardInterrupt, but this only catches the interrupt during sleep. If the server is already processing requests or other blocking operations, it may not respond immediately to Ctrl+C.

title: Missing statement start check in fmt skip logic
detail: The fix adds a check to prevent hidden code that starts a new statement from continuing the previous line. Without this check, when two statements both have '# fmt: skip' on opening brackets, the second statement's keyword gets hidden with the first one's newline, causing a syntax error in the output.
